description: This file defines a React component named 'NoteEditor' which provides a user interface for editing and saving notes. It manages local state for the note's title and content, and handles form submission to trigger the save operation.

methods.name: NoteEditor
methods.description: React functional component for editing notes, accepts props: note (optional), onSave callback, and saving status.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission events, prevents default behavior, and triggers the onSave callback with current title and content.
